case.rationale: Physical controller capability only; not an accepted judgment sweep point or anticipated compliance label.

value.public_highway: synthetic test assumption; not inferred from rendering
value.physical_driver: modeled controller acting on conventional passenger vehicle
value.official_devices: native asset identity is not proof of public legal authority
witness_required_context: Establish highway dedication and public availability, both speeds, separation, surrounding traffic and highway condition throughout following.
Identify ego's ordinary physical-control driver and both qualifying vehicles.
Identify the driver and both vehicles, and establish public-highway status.
Make the control vehicle a qualifying moving lead vehicle during an actual following interval before the lane change.
Make the separate control vehicle a qualifying moving lead vehicle in ego's initial lane and establish an actual following interval before the lane change.
Provide connected lanes and a supported lane-change route containing the hill crest.
Provide connected lanes supporting the intended lane change in a scene containing a hill crest.
Retain both speeds, separation, traffic and highway conditions through the following interval without selecting a reasonable-and-prudent cutoff.

unresolved_judgment_calls.note: tier S: 'reasonable and prudent' is the whole standard; the headway bound is a surrogate
